verse.line: Choose the right when a choice is placed before you.
In the right the Holy Spirit guides;
And its light is forever shining o'er you,
When in the right your heart confides.
Choose the right! Let no spirit of digression
Overcome you in the evil hour;
There's the right and the wrong to ev'ry question;
Let us make our voices heard resounding
In the truth that God loves right;
Every angel's voice in heaven's sounding
Choose the right! Choose the right!
